id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

menuPreview.description: Configuration of the onboarding guide to be used in the list of onboarding guides

readOnlyGuideRoles.description:
An optional list of roles that should _not_ be able to click a guide in the onboarding modal to view more details.
By default, if left empty or null, _all_ roles will be able to click a guide to view more details. For roles in
this list, the guide subtitle will be replaced with a link to reach out to admins to request access.

enabled.description: Whether the guide should be appear in the UI

displayIndex.description: Index used for sorting the onboarding guides in the UI

pendoGuideId.description:
Id of the Pendo guide that will be triggered from a {@link GenAiUiPendoGuideButton} in the onboarding guide
when the user is in a non-tutorial {@link Genai.Project}.
No button will be rendered in the default {@link Genai.Project} if this field is not defined.

tutorialModePendoGuideId.description:
Id of the Pendo guide that will be triggered from a {@link GenAiUiPendoGuideButton} in the onboarding guide
when the user is in a tutorial {@link Genai.Project}.
No button will be rendered in the tutorial {@link Genai.Project} if this field is not defined.

targetPage.description:
{@link UiSdlRoute} of the feature described by the onboarding guide. The button to "Start Tutorial" will redirect to this route
and trigger the onboarding guide defined in #pendoGuideId

videoGuideUrl.description: If defined, a link to this video will be displayed in the UI, which will open the video in a new tab

title: An onboarding document for the Enterprise Search application.
name: Genai.OnboardingGuide
